report.raw: {"schema_version":"m0-report-v2","assessment_status":"completed","conclusion":"supported","summary":"The alert fires because checkout's PlaceOrder server spans error whenever the payment service rejects a charge. In the failing trace (trace_id 3c40b4899bce09768d8626092731e775) the payment service's own span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge carries STATUS_CODE_ERROR with grpc.error_message and exception.message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold', raised at module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13); checkout's PlaceOrder span reports 'failed to charge card ... rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' with rpc.grpc.status_code 13, and the frontend request returns HTTP 500. Payment Charge error counts equal checkout PlaceOrder error counts at every sampled point in the hour, and checkout's other operations show zero error spans, so the failing operation is payment's charge path, not checkout's own logic. The deepest observable cause is payment's flagd-gated failure path: flagd served feature flag key paymentFailure with variant '100%' (159.11 impressions over 24h) as well as 'off' (285.20), all with reason STATIC, and payment evaluates the flag per charge through a grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat child span; the error text carries the same evaluation-context attribute (app.loyalty.level=gold). The 5-minute PlaceOrder error share reached 100% at 18:17:51 (10.0 ERROR vs 0 UNSET) and about 86% in the window ending 18:29:51 (7.5 ERROR vs 1.25 UNSET), matching the ALERTS pending/firing samples seen 18:15:21-18:20:51 and 18:27:21-18:32:51. The same payment charge failures also occurred earlier in the 24h window (e.g. 12:16-13:16 and 15:26-16:36 UTC), so this looks like a chronic injected failure that pushes the 5-minute ratio above 50% when a small number of PlaceOrder attempts happen to be flag-failing, rather than a new checkout defect; incident.acceptance_step: eval-suite development baseline (not an acceptance step)

stimulus.question: Checkout is reported to show elevated errors in the OTel Demo. Using the authorized metrics range query and trace search for the last 5 minutes, determine whether checkout and its dependency calls (payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping, email) show failures or elevated latency, cite trace ids, and return a json investigation report.

claims.text: The ALERTS series for alertname CheckoutPlaceOrderErrorRatioHigh (service checkout, severity critical) shows pending samples at 18:15:21-18:16:51, firing samples at 18:17:21-18:20:51, then pending at 18:27:21-18:28:51 and firing at 18:29:21-18:32:51 (last sample in the view).

checkout span metrics show oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (span_kind SPAN_KIND_SERVER) increasing by about 20.45 spans with STATUS_CODE_ERROR and about 74.64 spans with STATUS_CODE_UNSET over the 60-minute window ending 18:36:11; no other checkout operation (oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart, oteldemo.CheckoutService/prepareOrderItems, oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert, oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote, oteldemo.ShippingService/ShipOrder) had a non-zero error increase.

In the 5-minute window 18:24:51-18:29:51 the PlaceOrder server spans increased by 7.5 spans with STATUS_CODE_ERROR and 1.25 spans with STATUS_CODE_UNSET, i.e. an error share of roughly 86%, above the 50% threshold named in the alert summary.

The 60-minute series for oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder shows the 5-minute error increase reaching 10.00004 with STATUS_CODE_UNSET at 0 in the window summarized at 18:17:51 (all PlaceOrder spans counted there carried STATUS_CODE_ERROR), matching the alert description '100% of checkout PlaceOrder server spans ended in error over the last 5 minutes'.

The payment service's own span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (service payment, service_version 2.0.2) carries error status with grpc.error_message and exception.message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' and a stacktrace 'Error: Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold at module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13)', with a child span charge and a child span grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat (rpc.grpc.status_code 0).

In the same trace 3c40b4899bce09768d8626092731e775 the checkout span oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder errored with otel.status_description 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' and rpc.grpc.status_code 13; its child checkout span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge errored with rpc.grpc.status_code 2 and status description 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold'; the frontend span POST /api/checkout and the frontend-proxy and load-generator spans on the same trace recorded HTTP 500.

Payment span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge error increases equal checkout span oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder error increases at the sampled 5-minute points of the hour (19.43 for payment at 18:35:11 and 20.45 at 18:35:41 versus 19.43 and 20.45 for checkout PlaceOrder), while the same payment series shows non-error spans (STATUS_CODE_UNSET) of 73.62-74.64 over the hour.

Payment charge failures are not confined to the alert window: the 10-minute-bucket series for grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge STATUS_CODE_ERROR shows non-zero increases earlier in the 24h window, e.g. around 12:16-13:16 UTC (values up to 7.78) and 15:26-16:36 UTC (values up to 15.56), plus 24-hour totals of 147.11 ERROR versus 1960.41 STATUS_CODE_UNSET.

flagd (service_name flagd, k8s_deployment_name flagd, k8s_pod_name flagd-d6485586b-vhr8v, service_version v0.12.8) served feature flag key paymentFailure with feature_flag_result_variant '100%' (159.11 impressions over 24h) and 'off' (285.20 impressions over 24h), all with feature_flag_reason STATIC (feature_flag_flagd_result_reason_total increase 444.32 for that key).

The paymentFailure '100%' variant impressions are non-zero in the same 10-minute buckets as the payment charge-error bursts (e.g. 12:16-13:16, 15:26-16:36 and 17:56-18:36 UTC, with 15.56 in the bucket ending 18:36:24) and zero in long stretches such as 02:00-12:00 UTC where charge-error increases were also zero.

Across the last hour the error-status span query returned non-zero error series only for the checkout/payment PlaceOrder-Charge path and its frontend/frontend-proxy/load-generator callers; cart and product-catalog appear only with zero-valued error series, no error series was returned for accounting, currency, email, fraud-detection, image-provider, kafka, quote or shipping, and checkout's client spans to CartService, ProductCatalogService, CurrencyService and ShippingService all show zero error increase.

The PlaceOrder 5-minute series shows STATUS_CODE_ERROR increase of 0 at 18:33:51 and 0 at 18:34:51 while STATUS_CODE_UNSET was 2.5 and 7.5, i.e. the span-derived error share was not above 50% at the instant Alertmanager reports the alert starting (18:34:51); the ratio is intermittent and the alert state after 18:32:51 was not delivered.

Rejected: checkout's own operations or its other dependencies (cart, product-catalog, currency, shipping) are the failing element. checkout error spans in the hour exist only for oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and its client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (20.45 each), while prepareOrderItems, CartService/GetCart, CartService/EmptyCart, ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, CurrencyService/Convert, ShippingService/GetQuote and ShippingService/ShipOrder show zero error increase.

Rejected: latency, timeout or transport unavailability of payment caused the failures. The failing payment Charge span completed in 22,718 us and the containing checkout PlaceOrder span in 76,566 us, and the recorded error is an application exception thrown inside payment's charge.js with message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold', while the checkout client span returned rpc.grpc.status_code 2 (UNKNOWN), not a deadline or UNAVAILABLE status.

Most likely upstream cause: payment's flagd-gated failure path returns the '100%' variant of feature flag key paymentFailure for some charges (payment evaluates it through the grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat child span under its Charge span), and payment's code raises 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold'; the scale fits (159.11 '100%' impressions versus 147.11 errored payment charges over 24h) and '100%' impressions are non-zero in the intervals where charge errors occur.

The flag variant appears to be selected by the request's loyalty-level context: the failure message embeds the evaluation attribute 'app.loyalty.level=gold', and flagd serves both 'off' and '100%' for the same key with reason STATIC, consistent with a static targeting rule that gives loyalty-level-gold charges a 100% failure variant. Direct proof of the targeting rule is not available, because flag configuration is not observable in this Run.

The 50% threshold is crossed partly because PlaceOrder volume is low: the 5-minute PlaceOrder span increase is in the single digits to low twenties, so a short run of flag-failing charges swings the 5-minute ratio from 0 (0 ERROR versus 7.5 UNSET at 18:34:51) to about 86-100% (18:29:51 and 18:17:51), while the same charge-failure pattern existed earlier in the day without a delivered ALERTS episode.

Review the flagd flag configuration and any config change history for key paymentFailure (variants 'off' and '100%', reason STATIC) and confirm whether 100% failures for loyalty-level-gold charge requests are intended; this is the path producing the PlaceOrder errors behind the alert.

Review the definition of checkout_placeorder_error_ratio (evaluation window, denominator and minimum traffic) because 5-minute PlaceOrder volume is low enough that the span-derived ratio alternates between 0% and 100% within the same hour.

The trace view that supplied the failing-trace error details and its 6-row re-read (a04b7cbb-e042-4fcc-a74b-37f9cb708735-t0:b3650a8c-970b-45be-9345-2b33506be5cb and a9d32175-f326-451e-83c5-d3f0584432a0-t0:f768f670-0df8-4fb2-b493-fe86db05cb34) are marked incomplete and truncated (96 and 115 rows omitted of 121); only the rows shown are observed, so per-trace error coverage is not complete.

Only one failing trace's error details were read; whether every one of the roughly 20 hourly payment Charge error spans carries the same 'Invalid token' message is not directly observed, only that payment and checkout error counts match at the sampled points.

change_history is not integrated, so it is unknown whether the flagd paymentFailure flag configuration/targeting or the payment deployment changed during the window; the same failure pattern earlier in the 24h window is consistent with a chronic configuration but does not prove it.

kubernetes_state is not integrated, so pod, replica and image state for payment (service_version 2.0.2) and flagd (pod flagd-d6485586b-vhr8v, deployment flagd) could not be checked for restarts, rollouts or config-only changes during the incident window.
pod_logs is not integrated, so payment and flagd logs were not available to confirm the evaluation context (app.loyalty.level=gold) and the resolved variant for individual failed charges.

payment exposes no rpc_server_duration_milliseconds series: a query with service_name="payment" and label rpc_grpc_status_code returned no_data (evidence 58044590-ea67-4f03-9ced-f508d057dad1-t1:d9ff2e05-2a4c-4fb5-9ae3-cc77940c5b5e), and the service_name values returned for that metric were only ad, checkout and product-catalog, so payment's server-side gRPC status codes could not be cross-checked through rpc_* metrics.

report_parsed.summary: The alert fires because checkout's PlaceOrder server spans error whenever the payment service rejects a charge. In the failing trace (trace_id 3c40b4899bce09768d8626092731e775) the payment service's own span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge carries STATUS_CODE_ERROR with grpc.error_message and exception.message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold', raised at module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13); checkout's PlaceOrder span reports 'failed to charge card ... rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' with rpc.grpc.status_code 13, and the frontend request returns HTTP 500. Payment Charge error counts equal checkout PlaceOrder error counts at every sampled point in the hour, and checkout's other operations show zero error spans, so the failing operation is payment's charge path, not checkout's own logic. The deepest observable cause is payment's flagd-gated failure path: flagd served feature flag key paymentFailure with variant '100%' (159.11 impressions over 24h) as well as 'off' (285.20), all with reason STATIC, and payment evaluates the flag per charge through a grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat child span; the error text carries the same evaluation-context attribute (app.loyalty.level=gold). The 5-minute PlaceOrder error share reached 100% at 18:17:51 (10.0 ERROR vs 0 UNSET) and about 86% in the window ending 18:29:51 (7.5 ERROR vs 1.25 UNSET), matching the ALERTS pending/firing samples seen 18:15:21-18:20:51 and 18:27:21-18:32:51. The same payment charge failures also occurred earlier in the 24h window (e.g. 12:16-13:16 and 15:26-16:36 UTC), so this looks like a chronic injected failure that pushes the 5-minute ratio above 50% when a small number of PlaceOrder attempts happen to be flag-failing, rather than a new checkout defect; change history, Kubernetes state and pod logs are not integrated, so whether the flag configuration or a deployment changed cannot be verified.
